The FloPlast AF32W air admittance valve, is a crucial plumbing component designed to prevent odours from drainage systems by allowing air into the waste pipework when negative pressure occurs. This makes it ideal for installations where traditional external venting is impractical or impossible, such as loft conversions or basement bathrooms. The universal design provides a versatile solution, fitting standard 32, 40, and 50mm solvent weld waste pipes, ensuring compatibility across a wide range of plumbing systems. Its robust construction delivers reliable performance, maintaining efficient drainage and preventing foul air from entering occupied spaces. The white finish offers a discreet and clean aesthetic within internal installations. Supplied in card/paper packaging suitable for kerbside recycling.
